_documentation.purpose: Configuration for iganet_lin_elasticity_3D_multipatch_parametrized.cxx (LBFGS-trained IgANet multipatch example, supports per-patch boundary conditions via patches_3d).

test_cases.ACTIVE (complex: stretch + opposite shea: diri_sides [[1,0,0,0],[2,0.3,0,0]], force_sides [[3,0,0,-10],[4,0,0,10]], tfbc_sides [5,6]. Left clamped, right pulled 0.3 along x, and the bottom (side 3) and top (side 4) faces are loaded with opposite z-tractions, so the chain is stretched and twisted/sheared at the same time. Max displacement per direction in the reference: x 0.35, y 0.25, z 0.29 (clearly visible at 1x).
test_cases.simple (axial stretch, clearly visible a: diri_sides [[1,0,0,0],[2,0.5,0,0]], force_sides [], tfbc_sides [3,4,5,6]. Left face clamped, right face pulled 0.5 along x (25% strain) with free sides: the chain visibly elongates and narrows (Poisson contraction). Check: reference u goes monotonically from 0 to 0.5.
test_cases.bending (small, use --exaggerate 10 in t: diri_sides [[1,0,0,0],[2,0.5,0,0]], force_sides [[3,0,0,-1],[4,0,0,-1]], tfbc_sides [5,6]. Traction on the y faces adds a bending of only ~4% of the height.
test_cases.shear (extreme, do not use for validatio: diri_sides [[1,0,0,0],[2,0,0,3.0]] pulls the free end 3 units sideways: patches fold into each other, far outside linear elasticity.
test_cases.rule: A side must not appear in both tfbc_sides and force_sides (the C++ trainer would optimize two conflicting targets there).

notes: geometry.mode can be 'xml' (loads multipatch_xml_path) or 'parametric' (built procedurally in code).
geometry_spline and solution_spline must match (isoparametric solution space).
patches_3d sets per-patch Dirichlet (diri_sides) and traction (force_sides) boundary conditions, addressed by each patch's xml_id.
simulation.min_loss/min_loss_change/min_loss_rel_change from the IgANet core are hardcoded to (near-)disabled in this example; simulation.max_epoch is the only effective stopping criterion.

multipatch.num_patches/cube_size are read by std_collocation_python/run_multipatch_reference_3d.py (the classical collocation reference solution) to build a chain of that many unit cubes (edge length cube_size each) glued along x; side 1 is only the leftmost patch's x=0 face, side 2 only the rightmost patch's far x face, sides 3-6 apply to every patch's y/z faces. The IgANet trainer (iganet_lin_elasticity_3D_multipatch_parametrized.cxx) still hardcodes 2 cubes independently of these fields.
